content.title: High Potential Renewed For Season 3, Showrunner Todd Harthan Departing - IMDb
content.text: High Potential Renewed For Season 3, Showrunner Todd Harthan DepartingMorgan Gillory is staying on the case: ABC has renewed "High Potential" for Season 3, TVLine has learned.Unfortunately, the show will be forging ahead without Todd Harthan, who has served as showrunner for both seasons of "High Potential" thus far. Harthan will be departing to focus on developing the live-action adaptation of "Eragon" at Disney+. A replacement showrunner will be announced at a later date."High Potential" stars Kaitlin Olson as Morgan Gillory, Daniel Sunjata as Adam Karadec, Javicia Leslie as Daphne Forrester, Deniz Akdeniz as Lev "Oz" Özdil, Amirah J as Ava Gillory, Matthew Lamb as Elliot Radovic, Judy Reyes as Selena Soto,...See full article at TVLine.com3/5/2026by Andy SwiftTVLine.comSimilar NewsDisney+Daredevil: Born Again Delivers a Major Death That Changes Fisk Forever4/15/2026by Naser NahandianGazettelyDaredevil: Born Again Star Ayelet Zurer Shares Surprising Revelation About Episode 5's Flashbacks (Exclusive)4/15/2026ComicBookMovie.comThe Mandalorian and Grogu is set to reach new lows for the Star Wars franchise at the box office4/15/2026by William JonesWinter Is ComingKaitlin OlsonA Full Timeline Of Blake Lively & Justin Baldoni’s ‘It Ends With Us’ Feud In Court, Online & In The Media4/14/2026by Dessi Gomez and Dominic PattenDeadline Film + TVHow High Potential's Fanbase Affected Season 2's Romantic Storylines4/11/2026by Andy SwiftTVLine.comDaniel Sunjata‘High Potential’: Fans Debate Who Has Better Chemistry With Morgan: Karadec or Wagner (Poll)4/13/2026TV Insider‘High Potential’: Kaitlin Olson Weighs in on Karadec vs. Wagner for Morgan4/9/2026TV Insider‘High Potential’: Kaitlin Olson Reveals Morgan’s Most Important Work Relationship4/8/2026TV InsiderIMDb.com, Inc. takes no responsibility for the content or accuracy of the above news articles, Tweets, or blog posts.
